title: Warmly Smoked Peruvian Fish Robata-Grilled Tiradito
description: A rich and creamy Peruvian dish featuring Gran Marnier, rendered fat, and a focus on flavor rather than heat. Perfect for adventurous foodies and those following a Jain diet.

ingredients.name: Gran Marnier
ingredients.notes: orange liqueur adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Rendered Duck Fat
ingredients.notes: adds richness and creaminess to the dish

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.notes: balances the sweetness of the Gran Marnier

instructions: Season the Ahi Tuna with smoked paprika and set aside.
In a small saucepan, heat the rendered duck fat over low heat.
Add the Gran Marnier to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the sliced Ahi Tuna to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the cooked tuna to a plate and top with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
